name: Intelligence
vision_statement: AI requests are handled in the best way possible, given all relevant information.
opportunities: Which request deserves which handling changes as models and the person's intents change, so each part of handling a request is a swappable solution with its own measure.
solution_coherence: Intelligence turns one request into a response. Quest Intents says which of the person's quests the request serves. Subconscious finds the cards the request needs before it is asked for, from Card Store and Cards From Files, and Context Retriever picks among them. Mind plans the request in steps, through Planner and Context Intake, and Quest Work Shown tells the person what is happening. Critical Thinking holds the work to a measure through Metric Translation, Goal Completion and Response Quality, and Quest Autopilot starts standing work only when the person allows it.
